description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Cheat Death: when you drop to 0 HP and aren't killed outright, the module asks how many Uncommon or Rare replicated items to disintegrate - your HP become 20 x that number (remove the items by hand). Magical Guidance: a Short Rest restores all Flash of Genius uses while you're attuned to a magic item (module).

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Cheat Death prompt at 0 HP and Magical Guidance on a Short Rest (module).
